hearings.text: The board’s explicit concern about excluding patients without smartphones necessitates a solution that preserves access. Evidence E2 shows 18% of patients lack smartphones or have unreliable data, making a full rollout risky. Evidence E1 reports a 12% reduction in no-shows in a two-week pilot, but without a control group, causality is unverified (E1 uncertainty). A stepped pilot mitigates this uncertainty by enabling real-world observation and adaptive scaling, aligning with the method of uncertainty-based decision-making (E1).
